title: MM3009_4h
extract_protocol_ch1: Ficoll centrifugation to isolate PBMC or BMMC.
RNA libraries were prepared for sequencing using 10x Genomic single cell gene expression procotol: mouse (v2) and human (v3).
description: All time points for the same patient were processed in the same batch.
data_processing: To minimize the potential batch effect, we analyzed each batch of mouse data separately. For each batch, raw sequencing data was processed using the 10x CellRanger pipeline, cellranger count followed by cellranger aggr (--normalize=mapped, mouse: cell ranger v2.1.0, mapped to mm10) to generate a UMI count matrix and then further processed using the Seurat (v2.3.4). Genes expressed in ≥ 3 cells were retained. Cells with gene counts less than 200 or more than 5000 were filtered out. The UMI count matrixes, which pass the above preliminary filtering and contain the data collected from all the samples from the same batch (01-04 or 11-14) or paralel batches (18-23) , are provided as the processed data.

Based on the mouse experiments, biological replicates prepared in parallel were highly reproducible. Thus, similar to the mouse analysis, different time points sampled from the same patients with the matched healthy control were processed by cellranger count/aggr (human: cell ranger v3.0.0, mapped to GRCh38, aggr: --normalize=mapped) and then by Seurat (v3.0.2) for quality control and pre-processing. Genes expressed in ≥ 3 cells were retained. Cells with gene counts less than 200 or more than 5000 or ≥ 20% mitochondria genes were filtered out. The UMI count matrixes, which passed the above preliminary filtering and contained the data collected from 3 time points and corresponding control for each patient, are provided as the processed data. To overcome human heterogeneity and to identify the same cell type or functional state in population, the data from different individuals were integrated by Seurat integration standard workflow.
Genome_build: Mouse: mm10. Human: GRCh38.

Supplementary_files_format_and_content: For the samples processed in the same batch (samples for each patient, mouse 01-04 or mouse 11-14) or parallel batches (mouse 18-23), the UMI count matrixes which were generated by cellranger aggr (--normalize=mapped) and passed Seurat preliminary filtering are provided.

metadata.source_raw_mean_definition: Mean of the deposited integer UMI counts after source CellRangeraggr mapped-read-depth subsampling; not original unsampled sequencing UMIs.
metadata.source_age_unit_policy: Age column has no printed unit; numeric ages treated as years by clinical-table convention, with original values preserved and this assumption explicit. Chemistry units not printed: preserve original values without inventing units.
metadata.source_clinical_time_policy: Injury, ISS and admission chemistry are baseline/admission covariates, not measurements at each later scRNA visit. SourceNAmeansNotavailable, never zero.
metadata.source_control_covariate_policy: Table1contains trauma patients only. Matched-control demographics and admission variables remain unjoined; do not copy values from the paired patient.
metadata.source_visit_timing_policy: Source4hlabel corresponds to originalGEOgroup<4h;24h/72hare nominal source visits, not exact draw timestamps. Ctrl is a different matched healthy donor, not preinjury blood from the patient.
metadata.source_gene_policy: Source-specific native gene-symbol rows retained. Source genes filtered at expression in at least3cells; omitted genes unavailable. No invented Ensembl IDs or outer-zero filling.
metadata.source_cell_scope_policy: Deposited preliminary-filtered RNA matrix rows; common500RNA/200genes/20percentMT QC. No exact author final-cell or doublet-filter reproduction claimed.
metadata.source_split_policy: Unassigned. All visits of one donor must share split; matched case/control technical pairs may require grouped sensitivity analyses. Global aliases unresolved.
